tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and app ground. Front Room is bright: white paper, with mist for panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Mist. One tone step from `surface`: panels, phone sheets, rows that hold a group. Surfaces step by tone, not by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks, wells, the body of a real table.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Broadcast cards over the match (scorebug, lower third). Solid white, never translucent, with `plate-lip` under them.

tokens.name: plate-lip
tokens.usage: The 6px lip under a TV card, so it lifts off any picture.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Notebook navy. All text and icons (15:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, captions, meta (7:1 on white, 6.4:1 on mist).

tokens.name: ink-on-plate
tokens.usage: Text on a TV card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card edges and hairlines inside real tables. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, switches (3:1 on white).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Robin red. The one action colour and what the room shares: the main button, progress, the room's pick on the TV, Pip's breast. Nothing else is robin, so robin always means 'this one'.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Robin on hover.

tokens.name: signal-lip
tokens.usage: The solid lip under a robin button; the press squashes it.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: A selected choice, a robin chip.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal` (4.6:1; labels are 16px bold or larger).

tokens.name: signal-edge
tokens.usage: Robin as text or a thin mark on white (5.9:1).

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch green. Big fields, the drawn pitch and the 'saved / on the TV' tick. White text only at 24px or larger (4.4:1).

tokens.name: pitch-deep
tokens.usage: Pitch stripes, and green text on white (6.9:1).

tokens.name: pitch-wash
tokens.usage: Success notices and chips.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow. Fields, the match minute tab, Ana's colour. Ink text only (10.6:1).

tokens.name: sun-wash
tokens.usage: Gentle notices, 'your pick is on its way'.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue. Fields and Rob's colour. Ink text only (5.6:1).

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: Sky chips.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Pink. Sam's colour. Ink text only (7.7:1).

tokens.name: pink-wash
tokens.usage: Pink chips.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The dark field, for contrast moments: the decision, the studio. White text 16:1.

tokens.name: navy-2
tokens.usage: A tone step on navy.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The live dot. Always with the word 'Live'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: access-plate
tokens.usage: The accessibility plate (captions, described-audio transcript). Invariant, and can never be outbid for screen space.

tokens.name: access-ink
tokens.usage: Text and the 2px keyline on `access-plate` (21:1).

tokens.name: club-kestrel
tokens.usage: Kestrel FC (fictional, home). Club colours are data: on that fan's own phone, team chips and charts, never on the shared screen when rival fans are present.

tokens.name: on-club-kestrel
tokens.usage: Text on `club-kestrel` (5.9:1).

tokens.name: club-ashvale
tokens.usage: Ashvale Athletic (fictional, away). Differs from Kestrel in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: on-club-ashvale
tokens.usage: Text on `club-ashvale`.
